scope: Opt-in Aiur source overlay; ordinary KZG transcript, opening witnesses and pairing anchors retained.

algorithm.ordering: Commitment/log/value observations and first-seen opening-factor order stay unchanged. Witness observations stay in native order.
algorithm.state: Each opening factor tracks its fixed r weight and next v power. Each row advances that power by its width.
algorithm.matrix_coefficient: For column j of matrix m, coefficient is v^j times the sum of r_weight * row_start_v_power across that matrix opening rows.
algorithm.generator: Sum all weighted claimed values and emit one negated generator term.
algorithm.witnesses: Original zeta * factor * r_weight and -r_weight terms retained.
algorithm.edge_cases: Zero-width rows still create point batches; repeated factor1/log0, zero v/r, mixed heights and current/next rows are covered. Zero-weight terms in synthetic edge cases are correctness coverage, not a speed claim.

actual_init.scope: Exact same input wires, policy and statement. Count-only; no proving traces allocated.

small_terminal.scope: Full small development terminal PLONK compilation; slight regression of 218 main cells and 2,444 constraints. No setup/proof from this compile.

validation.native_reference: Exact observed-byte vectors, v/r/next challenges and both group outputs agree over synthetic edge cases.
validation.aiur_reference: Source synthetic scalar edges agree with native; actual mixed-height/log0/zero-lookup proofs produce equal v/r/next and equal accumulator points for honest and forged opening witnesses.
validation.existing_source_tests: Honest/tampered key/claim/quotient/opening and compression-policy tests passed against the candidate.
validation.actual_compiled_verifier_proof: Passed: 2,587,844 main cells, height 65,536; altered output rejected. Explicit development setup.
validation.lean: Opt-in source typecheck and exporter build passed.
validation.large_proving: Actual Init count-only; no traces or PLONK circuit allocated.
